All 18 report tests pass; runtime for the large tenant test dropped from 12.84s to 2.91s. A real tenant build produced the same 14,802 aggregates while reducing SQL statements from 2,417 to 37.

Added webhook transport retries to `WebhookSender`: configurable `max_attempts` (default 3), exponential bounded backoff, validation for invalid attempt counts, and re-raising the final transport error after exhaustion. Added tests for eventual success and retry exhaustion. All six webhook tests pass. Remember to use short, descriptive commit messages.

Completed webhook retry improvements: transport errors and retryable 5xx responses retry with bounded exponential backoff, while client errors propagate normally. Added eventual-success, server-error, exhaustion, and non-retryable response coverage; all 8 webhook tests and the full suite pass (44 passed). Ruff and whitespace checks are clean.

Investigated search rebuild performance. Invoice scanning of 5,000 documents took 8.42 seconds, with per-document embedding identified as the bottleneck. Replaced serial embedding with an ordered, bounded thread pool (8 workers), reducing runtime to 3.16 seconds. Added request chunking (`CHUNK_SIZE = 100`), further reducing the profiled run to 1.87 seconds across 125 calls. Updated the rebuilder test mock to accept batched inputs; all 15 rebuilder tests pass.

A baseline index test run has two existing failures: rebuilt documents do not include recently updated invoice descriptions. This remains unresolved and should be investigated next.

Completed major search rebuild optimizations. Webhook retries now use bounded exponential backoff for transport/retryable 5xx failures, with full coverage; the suite was clean at that stage.

Search rebuilding now uses tenant-scoped queries, batched parallel embedding (8 workers, chunks of 100), a shared embedding client, and transactional bulk vector upserts. Added a unique migration index on `(tenant_id, document_id)` to prevent duplicates. Rebuild performance improved from roughly 8.4 seconds to 1.2 seconds for 5,000 documents; a 10,000-document benchmark reported a 2.41-second median versus 16.73 seconds previously. Search/rebuilder, storage, management-command, and full-service tests all pass: 247 passed, 4 skipped.

Current work: investigating a CSV export encoding failure. `tests/test_csv_export.py` has 1 failure and 6 passes because the exporter opens report files with the platform-default encoding, while the test expects correctly encoded UTF-8 bytes. Next, update `ledgerly/exporters/csv_export.py` to specify UTF-8 explicitly and rerun the CSV and full test suites.

Completed the search rebuild optimization and stabilized webhook retry behavior earlier: retries now use bounded exponential backoff, and rebuilding uses tenant-scoped, batched embedding plus transactional bulk upserts and duplicate prevention. Performance improved substantially, with all relevant search/storage/command/full-service tests passing.

In `ledgerly/billing/invoices.py`, `LineItem`, `build_invoice_lines`, and `calculate_totals` were annotated using `Decimal`, `Iterable`, and `TypedDict`; invoice behavior remained intact with all 12 tests passing and compilation succeeding. A test exposed an `apply_credit` ordering bug: after a refund, the invoice total remains `90.00` instead of the expected `87.50`, likely because `CreditMemo.amount` is added before `refund_total` is deducted.
